span.label: mechanisms
span.term: MOVE THE MODEL, NOT THE DATA: training happens locally inside each institution and only model characteristics leave the firewall, so the consensus model is built without the patient records ever being pooled
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: WHY ANONYMISATION CANNOT BE THE ANSWER: identity survives the removal of the obvious fields - a face is reconstructable from a CT scan, and a handful of record elements permits reidentification
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: DATA IS WITHHELD FOR COMMERCIAL REASONS AS WELL AS LEGAL ONES: curating a high-quality set costs time and money, which gives it business value and makes sharing less likely - a motive no privacy technology addresses
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: FL is stated to still require rigorous technical consideration to avoid compromising safety or patient privacy - the paradigm is offered as promising rather than solved
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: FL → Federated learning

span.note: FL enables machine learning from non-co-located data. Enablement is absent from the eight edge types and is not safely reducible to causation here.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Non-trusted → security strategies
span.note: Non-trusted FL collaborations require security strategies. Prerequisite-for is absent from the eight edge types.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: traceability and accountability processes → execution integrity
span.note: Traceability and accountability in non-trusted federations require execution integrity. Prerequisite-for is absent from the eight edge types.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: “honest broker” system → trusted third party
span.note: An honest-broker federation is administered through a trusted third party acting as intermediary. Administered-through or mediated-by is absent from the eight edge types.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: anonymisation - TREATED HERE AS INSUFFICIENT BY CONSTRUCTION, not as imperfect in practice: removing name and date of birth does not preserve privacy, a face can be reconstructed from a CT scan, and genomic data is as unique as a fingerprint
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Federated learning - collaborative model training without exchanging or centralising the parties' data sets
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Aggregation-server FL - nodes receive a global model, train locally, and return partial models for central aggregation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Peer-to-peer FL - each node exchanges partial models with peers and performs its own aggregation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Centralised training - sites donate data to a shared lake for extraction and independent local training
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: FL topology - centralised, decentralised, or hierarchical communication architecture
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: FL compute plan - trajectory followed by a model across participating partners
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Data heterogeneity - non-IID cross-institutional distributions that challenge federated aggregation and local optimality
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Privacy-performance trade-off - stronger federated protections may affect final-model accuracy
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Non-trusted federation - collaboration needing encryption, authentication, traceability, verification, integrity, and adversarial defenses
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Federated information leakage - model changes exposed to multiple parties create reverse-engineering risk even without raw-data sharing
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Honest-broker administration - trusted intermediary controls the federation and abstracts internal mechanisms from clients
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Peer-to-peer administration - sites interact directly with no gatekeeper and must synchronise protocol changes
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
